tagline: Leading financial technology company providing self-directed banking solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: The transition to a recurring revenue model is a key strategy for Atleos, aimed at improving cash flow stability and increasing enterprise valuation.

kpis.short: Recurring Revenue as % of Total Revenue
kpis.name: Recurring Revenue (% of Total Revenue)
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total revenue derived from recurring sources, such as subscriptions or ongoing services.
kpis.description: This KPI measures the portion of revenue generated from long-term contracts or continuous services, reflecting the stability and predictability of the company's revenue.
kpis.signal: Indicates a shift toward a more predictable model, although slightly declining.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total amount of revenue generated by the company over a given period.
kpis.description: Total revenue represents all sales of goods and services before deduction of costs.
kpis.signal: Modest but positive growth in overall revenue.

kpis.name: All other products and services
kpis.explanation: Revenue from products and services not classified as recurring revenue.
kpis.description: This category includes one-time or project-specific revenue.

kpis.name: ATM as a Service (ATMaaS)
kpis.explanation: Comprehensive service offering for managing automated teller machines as a service.
kpis.description: ATMaaS is an integrated offering that simplifies the management of self-service banking channels for financial institutions, including back-end services, cash management, and ATM deployment.
kpis.signal: Key strategy for a recurring revenue model with strong growth.

kpis.name: Self-Service Banking Segment
kpis.explanation: Business segment focused on self-service banking solutions including ATM hardware and software.
kpis.description: This segment includes hardware, software, and services related to automated tellers and self-service solutions for financial institutions.

kpis.name: Network Segment
kpis.explanation: Segment providing access to a network of automated teller machines and financial kiosks.
kpis.description: This segment includes the Allpoint network, offering fee-free cash withdrawals and deposits, as well as ATM management services for retailers.
kpis.signal: Facilitates access to financial services for customers.

kpis.name: Telecommunications and Technology (TT) Segment
kpis.explanation: Segment offering managed network and infrastructure services to enterprises.
kpis.description: This segment provides professional services for modern network technologies through direct relationships with communications service providers.

kpis.name: Separation Costs
kpis.explanation: One-time expenses related to the separation from NCR Corporation.
kpis.description: These costs include setting up systems, separating operations, and employee-related expenses. They are expected to decline after 2026.

kpis.name: Recurring revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from long-term contracts or ongoing services.
kpis.description: This KPI measures the portion of revenue generated from long-term contracts or continuous services, reflecting the stability and predictability of the company's revenue.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in recurring revenue in 2025.

ai_positioning.summary: Atleos integrates technology solutions for the self-service banking sector, including cloud-based software features and APIs to improve operational efficiency and revenue predictability.
evidence: Atleos operates two leading business segments focused on facilitating self-service banking through ATMs supported by a shared set of tools, systems and platforms.

We are continuing our transition to software-led solutions. Today, our software platform, which runs in the cloud and includes microservices and application programming interfaces (APIs) that integrate with our customers systems, and our ATMaaS solutions, bring together all our capabilities and competencies to power the technology to run our customers self-directed banking networks, at the same time allowing us to earn a greater proportion of recurring revenues.

We believe it will build on our leadership in self-service banking and ATM networks to meet global demand for ATM access and leverage new ATM transaction types, including digital currency solutions, to drive market growth.
